Several weeks (travel all over Tibia, 20 h cooldowns and 5 wins in the Dream Scar, where the champion only changes at each Server Save)

The messenger {npc:Myzzi}, north-east of Edron, opens the doors of the Dreamelves' courts for you. {npc:Vanys} (Court of Summer) or {npc:Undal} (Court of Winter) give you a {item:Dream Talisman} to charge 8 Ward Stones scattered around Tibia, two of them hidden behind missions in Tiquanda and in the Haunted House of the Plains of Havoc. Then you open the 7 Dream Doors of the {wiki:Dream Labyrinth}, win 5 fights in the {wiki:Dream Scar} and kill {creature:The Nightmare Beast}. You end up with access to both courts and the labyrinth, the {wiki:Powerful Vibrancy} imbuement, the base {wiki:Dream Warrior Outfits|Dream Warrior Outfit} and five achievements.
The Summer and Winter Courts need help fighting a great threat to the whole world.
Myzzi, north-east of Edron (wanders around a large area)
**Premium** account and level **250** (it is the minimum and also the recommended level).
Access to {wiki:Feyrist}: *Troubled Animals* mission of the {wiki:Threatened Dreams Quest} completed.

Access to {wiki:Okolnir} and {wiki:Tyrsung}: {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} done (without it {npc:Buddel} will not take you) and the *Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism* mission of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} at least started.
Access to {wiki:Meriana}: *Access to Meriana* part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}.
**Relic Hunter** rank in {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}, so that {npc:Captain Max} takes you to {wiki:Calassa}, and {wiki:Diving Equipment|diving equipment} ({item:Helmet of the Deep}).
A {item:Ghostsilver Lantern} from the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest} (in the Dream Labyrinth each team member needs their own).
A {item:Flask of Medusa's Ointment} from {wiki:The Cursed Crystal Quest} (also one per team member).
A {item:Broken Compass}: found in {wiki:The Extension Site} (during {wiki:The Secret Library Quest}) or bought from {npc:Andrew Lyze} for 10,000 gp.
{spell:Levitate}, to go down to the main wing of the {wiki:Buried Cathedral}.

for the Magical Paint (loot from the Dreamelves)

Money: 10,000 gp if you buy the compass, 5,000 gp for each new application of the Lucifuga Aranea bait, and the boat trips (20 to 200 gp each).
Access to the {wiki:Court of Summer}, the {wiki:Court of Winter} and the {wiki:Dream Labyrinth}
{wiki:Powerful Vibrancy} imbuement for boots (removes paralysis with a 50% chance)
Base {wiki:Dream Warrior Outfits|Dream Warrior Outfit} (male and female), when you report the Nightmare Beast's death

A prize from the {item:Brass-Shod Chest} with the violet charge: 3 {item:Violet Gem|Violet Gems}, 9 {item:Gold Ingot|Gold Ingots}, a {item:Bar of Gold}, a {item:Dragon Figurine} or a {item:Giant Emerald}

Boss loot: Izcandar drops the {item:Winterblade} (winter form) or the {item:Summerblade} (summer form), and the banished form, killed in the centre, can drop either of the two; the Nightmare Beast can drop {item:Ice Shield}, {item:Beast's Nightmare-Cushion}, {item:Enchanted Sleep Shawl}, among others
Court of Summer and Court of Winter
By saying {key:entrances} and {key:yes} to {npc:Myzzi}: her enchantment lets you pass through the courts' portals (Feyrist and the top of Tyrsung).
By asking {npc:Andrew Lyze} about {key:materials}: he opens the sealed cave entrance for you.
Compass recharges and Magic Portal chests
After the Unsafe Release mission, {npc:Andrew Lyze} recharges your compass with a crystal and 20,000 (blue), 50,000 (green) or 100,000 gp (violet).
Each type of charge entitles you to one Magic Portal chest once every 20 hours.
After restoring the portals of the Haunted Cellar, the Haunted Temple and the Haunted Tomb: you travel between them by spending {item:Green Ectoplasm}, {item:Red Ectoplasm} or {item:Blue Ectoplasm}.
With the three portals restored, through the green Magic Forcefield in the Haunted Cellar.
After charging the 8 Ward Stones and talking to {npc:Vanys} or {npc:Undal} again ({key:task}).
Dream Scar (a different champion each day)
After opening the 7 Dream Doors: the mosaic in the labyrinth's last room takes you to the arena.
After 5 wins in the Dream Scar, through the teleport south-west of the arena.
Dream Warrior Outfit (base) and its addons
When you report the death of {creature:The Nightmare Beast} to {npc:Vanys} or {npc:Undal}; from then on you can ask them for the addons.
Start with the **Court of Summer** ({npc:Vanys}): it is the easier court to access. {npc:Undal}, in the Court of Winter, gives exactly the same mission.

Against the Dreamelves use **energy** damage (neutral for both types). The summer ones reflect **fire** damage and the winter ones reflect **ice** damage: wear fire protection in the summer zones and ice protection in the winter zones.

While you move around the courts, keep {item:Sun Fruit|Sun Fruits}, {item:Dream Essence Egg|Dream Essence Eggs} and {item:Small Enchanted Sapphire|Small Enchanted Sapphires}: they are the ingredients of the {item:Magical Paint} that each team member will need in the labyrinth.
{creature:Faceless Bane} and {creature:The Nightmare Beast} have a **20-hour** cooldown. In the Dream Scar the champion changes at each Server Save and you need 5 victories: plan for several days.

In the Haunted House, after restoring the portals, you travel between the three zones by spending the ectoplasm of the zone you are in: {item:Green Ectoplasm} (drops from {creature:Ripper Spectre|Ripper Spectres}), {item:Red Ectoplasm} (from {creature:Gazer Spectre|Gazer Spectres}) or {item:Blue Ectoplasm} (from {creature:Burster Spectre|Burster Spectres}). They last 10 minutes.
It all starts with the messenger fairy Myzzi, who gives you the enchantment to pass through the portals of both courts.

Travel to **Edron** (by boat, say {key:edron} to a captain). Leave the city to the **north-east**: {npc:Myzzi} wanders a large area north of Stonehome and can be anywhere in it, so look for her around the marked spot.
Ask for access to the courts

Say {key:hi}, {key:entrances} and {key:yes}. Myzzi gives you her enchantment: from now on you can pass through the portals of the Court of Summer (in the meadows of Feyrist) and the Court of Winter (high in the mountains of Tyrsung). If you want the whole story, also ask about {key:good}, {key:help}, {key:threat} and {key:courts}.
Enchantment to pass through the court portals
The Court of Summer is in the meadows of Feyrist. Inside, Vanys gives you the main mission and the talisman for the Ward Stones.

Get a {item:Small Emerald}. In one of the cities in the table, go to the corridor with four arches (ice, earth, fire and energy) and step into the **earth** arch: you reach an earth shrine. **Use** the Small Emerald there (the gem is used up) and you are teleported to the Earth Shrine of {wiki:Feyrist}.
Top floor of the depot tower
Top floor of the shops building, north of the depot
Lower floor of the Noodles Academy's central tower
4th floor of the depot and shops building
Above the temple, up the stairs
Earth Shrine of Feyrist (where you arrive)
Holy Shrines corridor in Liberty Bay, with the four arches

You can also use another gem at the shrine of its element ({item:Small Sapphire} ice, {item:Small Ruby} fire, {item:Small Amethyst} energy), but you arrive at a different point of Feyrist, further from the court.
From the Earth Shrine head **east** to the portal north-east of the Fae Village and step into it. With Myzzi's enchantment you pass into the {wiki:Court of Summer}.
Court of Summer portal (north-east of the Fae Village)
Fae Village, in the centre of Feyrist
Go **north** to some stairs and go down one floor. {npc:Vanys} is on that underground floor.

Along the way there are many {creature:Crazed Summer Rearguard|Crazed Summer Rearguards} and {creature:Crazed Summer Vanguard|Crazed Summer Vanguards}. Do not use fire damage against them (they reflect it).

Say {key:hi} and {key:task}. Vanys explains that you have to charge **8 Ward Stones** to strengthen the Nightmare Beast's prison and gives you the {item:Dream Talisman}. Six stones are in known places (Okolnir, the Folda water elementals cave, Calassa, Feyrist, Meriana and Cormaya); the other two are clues: an abandoned house on the Plains of Havoc, east of an outlaw camp, and a small stone building south-west of Banuta, in Tiquanda.
If you lose the talisman, say {key:lost} to Vanys (or Undal) to receive another one.

Make the most of being in Feyrist: leave the court the way you came in (the wiki does not describe another exit from the court) and, in the meadows, go to the marked Ward Stone, between the Earth Shrine and the court portal. **Use** the {item:Dream Talisman} on the stone. A message appears saying you have charged the stone (*winter ward stone* with blue light or *summer ward stone* with golden light).
Use any of the four Holy Shrines of Feyrist: you return to the mainland without spending another gem (it does not matter which one you came in by). The closest is the Earth Shrine.
Undal gives the same mission as Vanys. You only need to go to the Court of Winter this way if you prefer to start there; in the labyrinth you pass through it again via an internal portal.

Travel by boat to **Svargrond** (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). At the dock **south** of Svargrond, talk to {npc:Buddel}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:tyrsung} (50 gp). You disembark at the dock of {wiki:Tyrsung}.

Buddel is always drunk and may drop you off in the wrong place. With a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack he takes you to the right destination and does not charge the 50 gp, but he keeps the ring; if you do not want to lose it, say {key:no} when he asks for it.
Climb to the Court of Winter portal
Go to the mountain in the centre of the island and climb it floor by floor via the marked points up to the top, where the {wiki:Court of Winter} portal is. Enter the portal.
In the Court of Winter, go to the **east** side and climb up to {npc:Undal}'s floor. Say {key:hi} and {key:task}: you get the same mission and the same {item:Dream Talisman} that Vanys gives.

Here there are {creature:Crazed Winter Rearguard|Crazed Winter Rearguards}, {creature:Crazed Winter Vanguard|Crazed Winter Vanguards} and {creature:Soul-Broken Harbinger|Soul-Broken Harbingers}. Do not use ice damage against them (they reflect it).
Leaving the Court of Winter and Tyrsung

The wiki does not describe a separate exit from the court: go back the way you came to the portal at the top of the mountain, climb down via the same points to the dock and tell {npc:Buddel} {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} to return to Svargrond.

There are 4 Ice Ward Stones and 4 Sun Ward Stones. Six are charged directly with the Dream Talisman (the Feyrist one is already done in section 2); the two hidden ones require the missions in sections 5 to 9.

For all of them you just **use** the {item:Dream Talisman} on the stone. You get the message *You charge the winter ward stone and the engraved ice crystal glows in a blue light.* or *You charge the summer ward stone and the engraved sun glows in a golden light.*
In **Svargrond**, at the dock to the **south**, tell {npc:Buddel} {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:okolnir} (50 gp). You disembark from his boat on {wiki:Okolnir}.
Climb the mountain, east of the boat, up to 2 floors above ground level and use the Dream Talisman on the Ward Stone.
Climb down the mountain the same way back to the boat and tell {npc:Buddel} {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}. If he drops you off on another island, ask for {key:svargrond} again.
In **Carlin**, talk to the boatman {npc:Nielson}, northwest of the city: {key:hi}, {key:folda}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You disembark at the docks of {wiki:Folda}, next to {npc:Svenson}.
Folda: going down to the water elementals cave

Enter the Folda dungeon through the main entrance inside the mountain or through the hole in the ice south of the mountain. Go down to the **3rd underground floor**: there are stairs just east of the main entrance on the 2nd floor (and others in the orc caves, in the southwest of the 2nd floor). The Ward Stone is in the water elementals cave; use the Dream Talisman on it.
Go up the same stairs to the surface and return to the docks. Tell {npc:Svenson} {key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes}: the trip back to the mainland is free and drops you off northwest of Carlin.

In **Edron**, tell {npc:Captain Seahorse} {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}. On {wiki:Cormaya}, go to the marked Ward Stone and use the Dream Talisman on it. To return to Edron, go to the **north** port of Cormaya and tell {npc:Pemaret} {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp).

In **Liberty Bay**, on the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot, tell {npc:Captain Waverider} {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp). On {wiki:Meriana}, go to the marked Ward Stone, near the entrance to the Meriana Gargoyle Cave, and use the Dream Talisman. To return, {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven, takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 50 gp).
Entrance to the Meriana Gargoyle Cave (reference)

In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Captain Max}, on one of the boats on the **east** side of the docks: {key:hi}, {key:calassa}, {key:yes} (200 gp). On the boat above {wiki:Calassa}, equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} (Captain Max sells it for 5,000 gp and buys it back for the same price) and jump to the sea floor.
Without the Helmet of the Deep (or other diving equipment) you drown underwater.
On the sea floor, go to the marked point and **go down** there: the Ward Stone is on the floor below. Use the Dream Talisman on it.
Go down here for the Calassa Ward Stone
Go back up at the same spot and return the same way to the area below {npc:Captain Max}'s boat; climb onto the boat and tell him {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} to return to Liberty Bay.
5. Unsafe Release: the Tiquanda Ward Stone
The seventh stone is in a sealed cave guarded by the dwarf Andrew Lyze. You need a charged compass to activate it.

Travel by boat to **Port Hope** ({key:port hope}). Walk through the {wiki:Tiquanda} jungle **northeast** to the small stone building south of **Banuta** (Vanys says southwest of Banuta). {npc:Andrew Lyze} is there, next to a sarcophagus that seals the entrance to a cave.
If you did not bring a {item:Broken Compass} from {wiki:The Extension Site}, buy one from Andrew: {key:hi}, {key:compass}, {key:sell}, {key:yes} (10,000 gp).

Say {key:materials}. To repair the compass, Andrew asks for 50 {item:Blue Glass Plate|Blue Glass Plates}, 15 {item:Green Glass Plate|Green Glass Plates} and 5 {item:Violet Glas Plate|Violet Glass Plates}, and opens the sealed entrance to the cave beneath him for you.
Looting the glass plates in Carnivora's Rocks

Go down into the cave ({wiki:Carnivora's Rocks}, 3 floors, level 250) and kill the Carnivors ({creature:Lumbering Carnivor|Lumbering}, {creature:Menacing Carnivor|Menacing} and {creature:Spiky Carnivor|Spiky Carnivors}) until you have the 50 blue, 15 green and 5 violet ones.
Repairing the compass and getting the Golden Axe

Return to Andrew with the plates and the Broken Compass and say {key:hi}, {key:materials}, {key:yes}: he exchanges the Broken Compass for a {item:Chargeable Compass}. When he asks whether you are ready to mine the crystals, say {key:yes}: he gives you a {item:Golden Axe} and applies a bait to you to lure the {creature:Lucifuga Aranea} spiders.
If you lose the Golden Axe, Andrew Lyze sells another one for 20,000 gp.

Use the {item:Golden Axe} on the crystal columns in the cave: {item:Crystal Column (Faceted)} on the 1st floor, {item:Green Crystal Stalagmite (Pillar)|Green Crystal Stalagmites} on the 2nd and {item:Red Crystals (Pillar)} on the 3rd. You need 5 {item:Blue Crystal (Item)|Blue Crystals}, 3 {item:Green Crystal|Green Crystals} and 1 {item:Violet Crystal}. Any column can give any colour; only the probability changes depending on the type of column.
With Andrew's bait active, walk around the cave's **3rd floor** near the {creature:Lucifuga Aranea} spawn points: it appears when you pass by. Kill it and take the {item:Poison Gland}.
The bait lasts **10 minutes**. If the spider does not appear in time, you have to go back to Andrew and pay 5,000 gp for him to apply it again. Do not lure too many spiders at once.
Return to Andrew with the 9 crystals and the Poison Gland and say {key:hi} and {key:unleash}. The compass becomes a {item:Charged Compass (Violet)}.

Use the Charged Compass on the stone ({item:Magic Portal}) just **north** of the hole that leads down into the cave. You end up in a small room with a {item:Brass-Shod Chest}: open it and choose your reward.
3 {item:Violet Gem|Violet Gems}, 9 {item:Gold Ingot|Gold Ingots}, a {item:Bar of Gold}, a {item:Dragon Figurine} or a {item:Giant Emerald}
3 {item:Green Gem|Green Gems}, 5 Gold Ingots, a {item:Crunor Idol}, a {item:Giant Ruby} or a Bar of Gold
2 {item:Blue Gem|Blue Gems}, 2 Gold Ingots, an {item:Ornate Locket} or a {item:Giant Sapphire}
Enter the Magic Portal **only once**. If you enter it again, you have to recharge the compass with another Violet Crystal and 100,000 gp before using it on the Ward Stone.
Return to {npc:Andrew Lyze} and say {key:hi}: your quest log is updated.

Go back down to the **3rd floor** of Carnivora's Rocks and go to its centre. Use the Charged Compass on the {item:Ward Stone (Summer)|Ward Stone}: this part is completed and the compass loses its charge.
Using the Charged Compass on the Ward Stone
Go up the same way to the entrance next to Andrew Lyze and walk back **southwest** through the jungle to Port Hope.

Later you can recharge the compass with Andrew at any time: a {item:Blue Crystal (Item)|Blue Crystal} + 20,000 gp, a {item:Green Crystal} + 50,000 gp or a {item:Violet Crystal} + 100,000 gp. Each type of charge lets you open the Magic Portal chest again, once every 20 hours, and is used up when you use it.
The eighth stone is in the Buried Cathedral. To get there you have to restore the portals of three interconnected haunted places: the cellar of this house, a temple in Tiquanda and a tomb in Darama.
The house is in the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, **east** of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp}. Walk from **Venore** to the **southwest**, or from **Thais** to the **east**, to the marked point.

Go down to the cellar of the house and talk to the ghost {npc:Stricken Soul}: {key:hi}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} and then type **your name**. He explains that the house is a nexus to a buried cathedral and that you have to restore three passages: one here in the cellar, one in the Tiquanda jungle and one in the Darama desert.

Explore the cellar ({wiki:Haunted Cellar}) up to the **southeast** room, where there is a skeleton in the middle of many {item:Spider Egg|Spider Eggs}. Use the skeleton to get a {item:Strange Empty Bucket}.
The cellar has {creature:Ripper Spectre|Ripper Spectres} and {creature:Arachnophobica|Arachnophobicas}.

Use the bucket on the {item:Mutated Egg|Mutated Eggs} scattered around the cellar. Not every attempt works: count on 5 to 15 eggs. The bucket fills up gradually: {item:Strange Empty Bucket} → {item:Bucket with Some Ectoplasm} → {item:Bucket with Ectoplasm} → {item:Bucket Full of Ectoplasm}.
Taking ectoplasm from a Mutated Egg
The ectoplasm drains from the bucket after 3, 2 or 1 minute, depending on how full it is: if you take too long between eggs, the bucket goes back to the start.

In a team: first clear the path from the skeleton to the north and then to the floor below. Inside the square of eggs next to the skeleton there is a safe spot where only one creature attacks you at a time. Solo: leave the Arachnophobicas at very low red health (they flee at 6 health); start with the four safe eggs in the lower passage that connects the two doors and do the southernmost stretch up to the rope hole (seven eggs along the way). On a sorcerer: bring them to red with strong runes (SD) or spells, then use a wand such as the {item:Energized Limb} or {spell:Apprentice's Strike} down to low red and finish with a {item:Wand of Vortex} (2 to 6 damage per hit); press Esc to stop attacking when the creature flees. When you come out of the hole, use {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bombs} to keep the spectres away, including next to the energy door.
Turning into a Slime and entering the room

With the {item:Bucket Full of Ectoplasm}, go back to the skeleton room and use the bucket **on yourself**: you turn into a {creature:Slime}. Then walk (with the arrow keys) into the door covered in {item:Pure Energy}, to the **west**: you are teleported into the room and this passage is restored.
Skeleton room (on the right) and the door with Pure Energy
Do not use the bucket on the door or try to open the door: use the bucket on yourself and walk into it.

The wiki does not describe how to leave this sealed room. Try going back through the Pure Energy door and retracing your steps to the stairs of the abandoned house; if you cannot find a way out, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your city's temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block / Protection Zone Block). You will come back to this room in section 9.
Travel to **Port Hope** ({key:port hope}). The {wiki:Haunted Temple} is **north** of the city, in the jungle: go to the marked point and go down.
Here there are {creature:Thanatursus} and {creature:Gazer Spectre|Gazer Spectres}.

Kill {creature:Gazer Spectre|Gazer Spectres} until you have 4 {item:Golden Idol of Tukh|Golden Idols of Tukh}. They are a semi-rare drop and disappear **10 minutes** after dropping, so kill quickly and do not waste time between them.
With the 4 idols, go to the **northwest** part of the cave and go down the stairs. Head to the room to the **west** and enter through the **southwest** door.
Room to the west (enter through the southwest door)
In the main room there are 4 slots. Use one idol on each: a red message appears confirming success and the temple passage is restored.
You can no longer leave through the door you came in by: go around via the **north**.

The vines growing in that passage take **half of your total health** if you step on them while they are growing. Walk slowly and carefully: two wrong steps in a row kill you. Mages can use {spell:Magic Shield} for extra safety.
Go back to the stairs you came down, climb up to the surface and walk back **south** to Port Hope.
Travel to **Darashia** ({key:darashia}). The {wiki:Haunted Tomb} is **west** of the city, in the desert: go to the marked point and go down.
Opening sarcophagi until you have 2 keys
Use the {item:Sarcophagus (Ectoplasm)|ectoplasm-covered sarcophagi} scattered around the cave. You need **2** {item:Strangely Ornamented Key|Strangely Ornamented Keys}.
Everyone in the room takes 50 to 600 earth damage and a {creature:Mummy} spawns
Everyone in the room becomes cursed ({wiki:Cursed}) and a {creature:Mummy} spawns
There is a **30-second** cooldown between sarcophagi and the keys disappear after **30 minutes**.
Using the pillars with a lock

With the 2 keys in your backpack, go to the **centre** of the dungeon, where there are two {item:Large Pillar With a Lock|Large Pillars With a Lock}. Use one of them: you are taken to a small room to the **north**.

In the room there is an {item:Onyx} on a small pedestal. Use it: the message *You reach for the onyx and trigger an enormous discharge of raw energy. It is now possible to traverse the portal in this tomb.* appears. The passage is restored and you are sent out of the room.
Go back the same way to the entrance and climb up to the surface. Walk back **east** to Darashia.

With the three passages restored, the nexus opens and you can enter the Buried Cathedral, beneath the sea south of Roshamuul. You have to discover the 4 words of a spell, defeat the Faceless Bane and charge the last Ward Stone.

Go back to the {wiki:Haunted Cellar}, to the room you entered covered in ectoplasm (enter as you did the first time: bucket full of ectoplasm used on yourself and the Pure Energy door, section 6), and step into the **green** Magic Forcefield. You arrive at the {wiki:Buried Cathedral}.

With the three portals restored you can also travel between the three haunted areas by spending the ectoplasm of the area you are leaving from: {item:Red Ectoplasm} in the Haunted Temple, {item:Blue Ectoplasm} in the Haunted Tomb, {item:Green Ectoplasm} in the Haunted Cellar. The wiki does not say where in the cellar you arrive.

From the entrance go **northwest**, follow the path **south** and then **north** again to the stairs and go down. On the 2nd floor, in a room right next to the stairs, take the {item:Acid Resistant Fishing Rod} from a pile of rubbish.
Use the book to learn about the spell's words
Go **south** and go down again, to the 3rd floor. Go **west** and then **south**, to a large pool of acid. Use the fishing rod on the pool: you get the first word, **K'muuh**.
Go back to the 2nd floor and go **east**, to the room with the water barrels. Use the barrel in the **northeast** corner of the room: second word, **O'kteth**.
Go **south** and follow the corridor **north** until you find a statue. Use it: third word, **N'ogalu**.

Go through the door to the **east** and go to the end of the corridor, then **north** and back **west**. The fourth word is hidden in a bed, in the last room to the **north**. When you find the last word you earn the achievement **Tied the Knot**.
Going down to the main wing
Go around the **west** side of the cathedral until you find a spot where you can go down with {spell:Levitate} to the main wing.
Reading the book and chanting the spell

In the centre of the room, click the small book next to the skull. Then use the large books in this order: **1.** northwest, **2.** southeast, **3.** southwest, **4.** northeast. *All chants have been sung in the right order, you are deemed worthy. You are transported away...* appears and you are taken to the boss room.
Once you have the four words, use the large books in the right order
The room has a lever and spots for up to **5 players**. Put the team on the spots and pull the lever to face the {creature:Faceless Bane}.
You have **10 minutes** to kill it; after that you are kicked out of the room. The boss has a **20-hour** cooldown.

At the start the boss heals all the damage it takes. To stop the healing, step on **all the Iron Floors** around the room: you get a **one-minute** window to take its health down. When it reaches low health, it summons one spectre of each type, heals fully and starts healing itself again; it heals like this **twice** before dying for good.

If you keep attacking after the minute, it goes back to full health, becomes invulnerable and the round starts over. Stop attacking before the 60 seconds are up and step on the Iron Floors again. Do not use **death** damage: the Faceless Bane is strong against it and reflects it; it is weak to fire.

A team with one blocker and 2 shooters is enough. Solo you will hardly have enough damage to kill it within each minute: attack, stop before the minute is up, step on the Iron Floors again and repeat. The blocker should use energy and death protection.
After killing the Faceless Bane, go to the cathedral's Ward Stone, on the **3rd floor**, just **north** of the acid pool, and use the {item:Dream Talisman} on it.
After the Faceless Bane you can use the Ward Stone

The wiki does not describe a separate exit from the cathedral. Go back the same way, climbing the floors, to the spot where you arrived through the green Magic Forcefield and return through it to the Haunted Cellar; from there go up to the abandoned house in the Plains of Havoc. If you get stuck, use a way back to the temple.
With the 8 Ward Stones charged, Vanys (or Undal) opens the Dream Labyrinth for you, where the Nightmare Beast's lair is. Before you enter, each team member needs three items.

Go back to the Court of Summer (section 2) and tell {npc:Vanys} {key:hi}, {key:task} and {key:keys}. She gives you access to the {wiki:Dream Labyrinth} through the court's portal and explains that you have to open 7 Dream Doors by solving puzzles. A scroll in the chest in the room tells you more about it.

Every player who goes with you into the labyrinth needs: a {item:Ghostsilver Lantern} ({wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}), a {item:Flask of Medusa's Ointment} ({wiki:The Cursed Crystal Quest}) and a {item:Magical Paint} (next steps).

Go to **Edron**, to the towers of the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy} (east side of the city). In {npc:Milos}'s tower (the second one), the {item:Wooden Grinder} is 2 floors above the ground floor and Milos is 4 floors up. Use a {item:Small Enchanted Sapphire} on the Wooden Grinder: you get {item:Sapphire Dust}.

Small Enchanted Sapphires are *uncommon* loot from {creature:Crazed Winter Rearguard|Crazed Winter Rearguards} (1 to 7 at a time) and rare loot from {creature:Crazed Summer Rearguard|Crazed Summer Rearguards}.
Get a {item:Sun Fruit}: it drops from the summer Dreamelves ({creature:Crazed Summer Rearguard}, {creature:Crazed Summer Vanguard} and {creature:Insane Siren}).
Inside the labyrinth there is a {item:Sun Fruit Bush}, but it only gives 2 fruits and takes a long time to grow more. If the team needs more than 2, collect them before or during the quest.

Use a {item:Juice Squeezer} on the Sun Fruit to get a {item:Bottle of Sun Fruit Juice}. Use the Sapphire Dust on the bottle to turn it into a {item:Bottle of Sun Fruit Juice (Sapphire)}. Finally mix it with a {item:Dream Essence Egg} (it drops from the Dreamelves of both courts): you get the {item:Magical Paint}.

The labyrinth has three floors, with summer Dreamelves, winter Dreamelves and mixed areas. The order of the doors is almost free, but this route saves time and supplies. There are many Dreamelves along the way: remember that the summer ones reflect fire and the winter ones reflect ice.
Collecting items in the Court of Summer

In the Court of Summer, pick a {item:Colourful Mushroom} from the {item:Tree Stump (Feyrist)} outside and take the {item:Anatomy Book} from a bookcase inside. Go up one floor and then another, to the 2nd floor, and take the {item:Rosebush (Item)|Rosebush} from a chest next to the labyrinth portal.
Rosebush chest, next to the labyrinth portal
Enter the portal next to the chest. You arrive at the {wiki:Dream Labyrinth}, at the bottom of the ocean to the west.
Follow the path **south**. In the small garden, use the Rosebush on the {item:Small Earth Heap} (the spot where a plant is missing). Then enter and leave the portal in the centre of this room.
This action has a **2-minute** cooldown: in a team, make sure everyone enters and leaves the portal before moving on.
Go back **north** and go down the stairs.
Take the {item:Minotaur Skull} from the chest to the **north**.
Go **west**, then **south** and **east**. Use a {item:Crowbar} (or a {wiki:Secret Agent Tools|Secret Agent Tool}) on the door to remove an {item:Old Lock}.
Go back **north** to a quest door. Use the {item:Flask of Medusa's Ointment} on it: you can now go through it.

Follow the map **west** to a wall. Equip the lit {item:Ghostsilver Lantern}. The hidden door is in a wall 4 squares long from north to south, beneath a 4-square grey stone lintel: use the grey stone that is the **third from the top** (on the map, where the blue arrow meets the red X). Enter and go up the stairs. Use the step 4 map as a guide.
Step 4: the blue arrow and the red X mark the hidden door
There are many creatures in this area. Know exactly where to click before you get there, or you may get surrounded while looking for the right square.
Go **west** and enter the small room to take the {item:Troll Skull}.

Go back **east**, then **south** and **east**, and follow the map to the small **northeast** room. If you have not finished the {item:Magical Paint} yet, finish it now and use it on the painting on the wall.
This painting also works as a portal between this area and the mixed area to the south.
Orc Skull in the Court of Winter
Go back the way you came and enter the portal to the Court of Winter. Go down one floor and pick up the {item:Orc Skull}. Return to the labyrinth through the portal, on the floor above.
Follow the map **northeast** and go down the stairs.
Follow the path **west** and then **south** to a quest door to the **east**. Eat a {item:Colourful Mushroom} so you can use it and go through.

Continue **east** and then **north** to a room with coffins. With the {item:Anatomy Book} in your inventory, use each skull on the right coffin: {item:Minotaur Skull} on the **left** one, {item:Orc Skull} on the **centre** one and {item:Troll Skull} on the **right** one. Then go through the door.
Follow the path and use the {item:Old Lock} on the quest door: you can now open it. When you solve the last door you earn the achievement **Keeper of the 7 Keys**.

Follow the path **southwest** until you find a portal (step 8 map). In the mosaic room (step 9 map) walk **south** to the centre of the room, where there is a mosaic: it is the portal to the {wiki:Dream Scar}.
Step 9: the mosaic in the centre leads to the Dream Scar
The portal to the **south** of this small room takes you back to the labyrinth, but only one way: if you enter it, you have to walk back or leave.
If a door does not open
If a quest door does not let you through, you failed its puzzle. Check the quest log and confirm the requirement of each door:
{item:Rosebush (Item)|Rosebush} (chest next to the Court of Summer portal), used on the spot without a plant in the small garden
{item:Magical Paint}, used on the painting in a room in the northeast of the labyrinth
{item:Anatomy Book} in your inventory and the {item:Orc Skull|Orc}, {item:Troll Skull|Troll} and {item:Minotaur Skull|Minotaur} skulls on the right coffins
The Dream Scar is an arena built to imprison the Nightmare Beast. Each day (at every Server Save) there is a different champion, for teams of up to 5 players. You need 5 victories to reach the beast.

Before you fight, talk to one of the arena's two Dreamelves and join the court they represent, to fight under its banner: {npc:Shirtalis of the Summer Court} (summer) or {npc:Farhilorn of the Winter Court} (winter). The wiki does not record their dialogue; start with {key:hi}.
By killing 20 champions while fighting for summer you earn the achievement **Champion of Summer**; for winter, **Champion of Winter**.
The champions always appear in this order, one per day. Since the boss changes at every Server Save (including emergency saves), the boss of the day may differ from world to world.
Earth, energy, holy, physical (ice in summer form, fire in winter form)
The element of the current form
Fire or ice, depending on the side

{creature:Plagueroot} appears with 3 {creature:Plant Attendant|Plant Attendants} and there are {item:Focus of Corrupted Nature|Focuses of Corrupted Nature} around the room. Do not let the Attendants step on the Focuses: they turn into {creature:Plant Abomination|Plant Abominations}, which are stronger (if it happens, kill the Abomination so it respawns as an Attendant). The earth attacks of both summons heal the boss: keep them away from it; the Attendants are weak and anyone can block them. The boss also heals if it steps on a Focus, so the blocker must not let it.

Every now and then Plagueroot teleports to another spot in the room and right afterwards casts a big **+**-shaped spell that deals 2000 to 3000. Shooters should be careful; use earth protection. Do not stand right in front of it.
It dies easily to single-target attacks and mage spells, but never use {spell:Terra Wave}.

This is the most dangerous champion in terms of damage. You first enter a small room with an NPC and, seconds later, you are teleported to the boss room. The blocker pulls {creature:Malofur Mangrinder} to the **southeast** side and traps it **east** of the exit teleport. The shooters stay in the **southwest**, where there is room, away from the Berserk-like attacks of the {creature:Whirling Blades} (up to 1700 damage; they cannot be killed).

The boss often starts the *BOOM* attack: 5 phases, one every 2 seconds, each with more damage and more range. The last BOOM hits up to 5000 and, added to the other attacks, the blocker can take 6000+. The knight should have {item:Stone Skin Amulet|Stone Skin Amulets} ready to equip after the 3rd or 4th BOOM. Shooters lose their target when the BOOM starts. There is a **20-minute** limit to kill it.
Unless the knight and the druid are very high level (600+), bring 2 druids to heal the blocker during the BOOMs.

{creature:Maxxenius} is healed by **energy** damage: nobody should use it. There are {creature:Generator|Generators} that constantly cast an energy spell around them and the outer squares of the room also pulse with energy, so block the boss away from those spots; the **northwest** of the room is ideal.

Maxxenius often turns its target into an {creature:Energy Elemental}. About 10 seconds later, that player *explodes* and deals 1000 to 1500 energy within a 2-square radius, which heals the boss: the transformed player has to move away from it.

With 2 knights it is easy: the one who is not transformed uses {spell:Challenge} and the other runs away. Without a second knight, a 350+ paladin and a mage with {spell:Magic Shield} can do it, as long as the team knows how to force the boss to switch targets quickly.

Probably the strongest champion. {creature:Alptramun} appears with several summons; when they die, even stronger ones spawn, and some of them heal the boss. Use plenty of area damage to keep killing them: the summons spawn near the centre and attack the nearest player, so the blocker stays in that area. The shooters spread out around the room, away from each other, to reduce the damage and the healing from the boss's lifesteal.
**Do not use {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes}**: they heal Alptramun. Do not stand in front of it (very strong death beam). Use death protection.

It often turns invisible: throw {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bombs} on the ground to reveal it faster. {item:Avalanche Rune|Avalanches} are good against the summons; sorcerers use their energy spells and druids use {spell:Terra Wave} whenever they can. The blocker should use {spell:Challenge} often.

{creature:Izcandar the Banished} has three forms: summer (fire), winter (ice) and banished (neutral). It changes form depending on the side of the arena it is on, always going through the banished form between summer and winter. Fire summons ({creature:The Heat of Summer}) and ice summons ({creature:The Cold of Winter}) spawn non-stop and are healed by the attack of their own element, so use earth, energy, holy or physical damage; area attacks help kill the summons and {item:Thunderstorm Rune|Thunderstorms} hit both.

The winter form is weak to fire and the summer form is weak to ice; SDs are a good single-target option. It may be a bit easier to finish it on the summer side (druids use {spell:Strong Ice Wave}): one strategy is to bring it to low health on one side and finish it on the other. The blocker should use {spell:Challenge} often.

At the end of the fight, leave the boss room through the exit teleport. To return to the court, cross the labyrinth in reverse (the doors are already open for you) to the Court of Summer or Court of Winter portal. To leave Feyrist, use any Holy Shrine (section 2).
Do not enter the portal south of the mosaic room unless you want to go back to the labyrinth: it is one-way only.
After 5 victories in the Dream Scar, the way to the final boss opens, for teams of up to 10 players. It is a fight that requires a well-coordinated team.
With 5 victories, go through the teleport to the **southwest** of the arena. On the other side you face {creature:The Nightmare Beast} with your team (up to **10** players).
**20-hour** cooldown. Use **death** protection (almost all of the beast's attacks are death) and life drain protection (the {creature:Nightmare Tendril|Nightmare Tendrils} have a life drain beam).

Shortly after you enter, one of the players becomes **cursed** and turns into a {creature:Spectre}. If the curse is not removed, after 25 seconds (15 as a Spectre and then 10 as a {creature:Phantasm}) they are teleported out of the room.
Recommended positions in the room (enlarge the image)
Removing the curse with the Dream Catcher

A player uses the {item:Dream Catcher Pole} in the centre of the room: a {item:Dream Catcher} appears in front of them. That player uses the mask on the cursed player: the curse passes to whoever used the mask. Nobody can heal themselves.
Taking the mask and using it on another player both have cooldowns. That is why players have to take turns.

Pick 4 or 5 players for this job beforehand, in a fixed order. The cursed player and the next one on the list always stay next to the totem. To gain time, wait for the transformation into a Phantasm before passing on the curse. The rest of the team focuses on the boss.

The beast switches targets often: it is best to trap it in the spot to the **west** of the room, where it cannot move to another target. It attacks in melee and hits up to 1000 damage at range. Mages use {item:Sudden Death Rune|SDs}. There are several {creature:Nightmare Tendril|Nightmare Tendrils} that respawn shortly after dying: a second blocker for them is recommended, but not required.
Nightmare Beast loot (e.g. {item:Ice Shield}, {item:Beast's Nightmare-Cushion}, {item:Enchanted Sleep Shawl}, {item:Turquoise Tendril Lantern}, {item:Purple Tendril Lantern})

Go back to {npc:Vanys} (or {npc:Undal}) and say {key:hi} and {key:task}. The quest is complete: you earn the achievement **Dream Catcher**, the base Dream Warrior Outfit and the ability to apply the {wiki:Powerful Vibrancy} imbuement to boots.
Dream Catcher achievement, base Dream Warrior Outfit and Powerful Vibrancy

From the beast's room, leave through the exit teleport and cross the labyrinth to the court's portal, as in section 12. From the Court of Summer, go back through the portal to the meadows of Feyrist and use any Holy Shrine to return to the mainland; from the Court of Winter, climb down the Tyrsung mountain and take {npc:Buddel} ({key:svargrond}).

The Dream Warrior addons are requested from the same Vanys or Undal: 5 {item:Pomegranate|Pomegranates} for the first one and an {item:Ice Shield} for the second. See the {wiki:Dream Warrior Outfits|Dream Warrior Outfits} guide.
After the quest you can keep fighting in the Dream Scar against the champion of the day and return to the Nightmare Beast every 20 hours.
Andrew Lyze recharges the compass whenever you want (crystal + 20,000, 50,000 or 100,000 gp), so you can open the Magic Portal chest again every 20 hours per type of charge.
Since version 12.08 the quest and Carnivora's Rocks require level 250.
